hero.title: Welcome to Chocósfera
hero.description: Discover the world where chocolate, blockchain technology and social justice come together to create a positive impact.

cacao.title: The Heart of Cacao
cacao.description: Our essence lies in ethically sourced cacao, cultivated with respect for the land and people. Each bean tells a story of tradition and authentic flavor.

blockchain.title: Innovation with Blockchain
blockchain.description: We use blockchain technology to ensure the traceability of each product, providing you with transparency and trust from the farm to your home.

justice.title: Justice for All
justice.description: Chocósfera is committed to fair trade and empowering producer communities, ensuring that every purchase has a positive social impact.
